question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aresst"** is incorrectly spelt and it should be "Arrest". The word "Arrest" means to stop or check (progress or a process). (गिरफ्तार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police managed to arrest the suspect last night.
 
 
 
• **"Arrest"** correctly refers to the act of seizing someone to take into custody. (गिरफ्तार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The quick actions of the police helped arrest the criminal before he could escape.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word is **"Arrest"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Express** (व्यक्त करना): To convey a thought or feeling in words or by gestures and conduct.

 
 
• **Example:** He wanted to express his gratitude for their support.
 
 
 
• **Excess** (अधिकता): An amount of something that is more than necessary, permitted, or desirable.
 
 
• **Example: **Eating in excess can lead to health problems.
 
 
 
• **Harass** (परेशान करना): To disturb persistently; torment, as with troubles or cares.
 
 
• **Example:** The employee reported that he was being harassed by his manager.
 
 

30:Tbdd,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
